fill_model.placement: every parent dW != 0 at boundary b|b+1 -> limit at close_b; buy L = close_b - spread/2 rounded DOWN to tick; sell L = close_b + spread/2 rounded UP
fill_model.spread: spread_b = max(1 tick, s_rel(sym) x close_b); s_rel per symbol = median over sampled days of median over minutes of (median ask-side print - median bid-side print)/mid from aggTrades is_buyer_maker; unsampled symbols = pooled median over sampled non-BTC/ETH symbol-days; numbers frozen in data/rebuild/exec_pf/spread_model.json by P0, never edited
fill_model.latency: order live from minute 1 of bar b+1 (minute 0 excluded)
fill_model.fill_rule: trade-through: buy fills iff any 1m low in minutes 1..59 <= L - 1 tick; sell iff any 1m high >= L + 1 tick; touch does not fill; fill price = L; single pre-declared tightening to 2 ticks if P0 fails once
fill_model.booking: simple returns, exact segment accounting: bar b+1 contribution = w_old x (L/close_b - 1) + w_new x (close_{b+1}/L - 1); unfilled LTM: w_old x (close_{b+1}/close_b - 1) then market at close_{b+1} charged spread/2 + taker on |dw|, w_new from bar b+2; adverse selection lives inside the PnL

policies.LTM: primary, gated: limit then market at bar end
policies.LOC: reported: entries/increases limit-or-cancel re-placed each boundary while parent wants more; reductions/exits limit-then-market
policies.taker: parity mode: fill at close_b at parent cost

fees.rf: R2 4.5%/yr full capital daily (parent); R1 none (parent)

fill_model.sr: daily UTC aggregation, mean/sd(ddof 1) x sqrt(365) for both signals; R1 parent hourly SR reported for parity
fill_model.missing_minutes: no fill; LTM market at close_{b+1} from the 1h store; parent fillna(0) return convention kept

probes.P0: tick-vs-1m calibration on the seeded sample: 1m-rule fill rate <= tick-level fill rate + 5 pp (tick truth: last bid/ask-side print at placement, print strictly beyond limit >= 60 s after placement); FAIL -> tighten to 2 ticks once; second FAIL -> STOP (model)
probes.P1: unconditional adverse selection: 2000 seeded random (symbol, hour, side) placements in dev; mean signed 5-min post-fill drift <= 0; else STOP (model broken); R2-event drift reported not gated
probes.P2: parity: taker mode reproduces R2 parent daily series to 1e-9 and SR 1.3047 to 1e-6; R1-BTC parent hourly SR -0.0804 to 1e-6 on the parent's log series at 5 bp (harness check); FAIL -> STOP (harness)
probes.P3: data integrity: 1m-rebuilt hourly close == 1h store close (|d|/close <= 1e-6) on >= 99.5% of overlapping dev bars per symbol; every ordered bar of the real paths has >= 55/60 minutes; tick consistency across months; FAIL -> STOP (data)

gates_dev_LTM.fill_rate_basis: limit-filled |dw| notional / total ordered |dw| notional (LTM market remainders = unfilled)
gates_dev_LTM.placebo: parent families through the passive overlay, 500 draws each, worse p <= 0.05; R2: A per-symbol circular trigger shift >= 24 bars, B count-matched uniform redraw within membership, seed 48; R1: A circular shift of P(up) min 30 bars, B 24h-block permutation of P(up)
gates_dev_LTM.cost_stress: maker 3.0 bp keeps sign of net SR
gates_dev_LTM.convention_swap: log booking at every PnL step keeps sign of net SR; both reported (rail 15)

reported_not_gated: mean adverse-selection cost per fill (L vs bar-end close)
top-name share of pooled gross PnL (R2)

multiplicity.rationale: fill model fixed pre-result, one frozen config per signal; cumulative ledger denominator reported

exec_pf.stop_rule: per signal any gate FAIL -> closed at the execution layer ('real, uneconomic even passive' / 'no edge to price'); no re-tuning of threshold, spread, latency, fee; PASS -> stop-and-decide with the user (F-window confirmatory >= 2027-01, registered then)
exec_pf.decisions: LTM primary; maker 2.0 bp; R0 pre-check included; worktree TradingAgents feature/exec-pf; bookDepth dropped (probed unusable)
exec_pf.mechanics: tradingagents/xsect/fills.py + tests/test_xsect_fills.py; scripts/fetch_vision_{1m,aggtrades}.py; scripts/exec_pf_{register,probes,run}.py; data/rebuild/exec_pf/; ledger experiment exec_pf; THESIS section 77

amendments.stage: after P2/P3/R0 probes, BEFORE P0/P1 and before any re-pricing number
amendments.trigger: P3 as registered failed on technicalities: 2/3846 ordered bars with no 1m data are bars absent from the 1h store as well (FILUSDT 2022-04-01 02:00 exchange gap; LUNAUSDT 2022-05-13 16:00 delisting); 8 cross-month tick flags = genuine Binance tick-size changes (2021, 2025) plus minimum-gap inference picking stale finer-grid prints (113 symbol-months, 28/854 R2 orders)
amendments.A1: the >=55/60-minute coverage requirement applies to ordered bars where the 1h store carries a close; bars absent from both stores fall under fill-model item 8 (no fill, zero return, cost charged = parent booking) and are listed
amendments.A2: tick inference = MODAL gap between sorted distinct prices per symbol-month (was minimum gap); modal is the conservative direction (deeper through-print, coarser rounding); cross-month tick consistency and the exchangeInfo cross-check are reported, not STOP
amendments.kept: close agreement >= 99.5% (observed min 99.997%) and A1 coverage remain STOP criteria

decision.R2: PASS-but-no-gain recorded as CLOSED at the execution layer; NO F-window passive confirmatory registered (liq_fade -0.79 on sealed window in combo_c1; passive < taker on dev)
